== English Reflections III comparison ==
The 2003 Rules Supplement calls the replacement a clarification. It limits the just-initiated battle to the same site and specifies the battle’s total power. The original prints a generic initiation and “power.” The companion Decipher ruling identifies this character as a Gamorrean. Neither original nor later image prints the species in its character attributes. Deploy, protection of alien leaders and maintenance costs retain the printed values.
